fields.statement: Built this branch's binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified. Two-leaf change set (second depends on first): rhiza run start --permission-mode manual ran build/build, build/check, render, review/code, review/review (5 of 5 checks), open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green and stopped at signoff; a fresh clone of the pushed cs/ship-it passed rhiza check; rhiza run approve ran rebase through land, merge, main-green, close-out and ship, change set landed, main passed rhiza check, no shipit anywhere. But after rhiza run request-changes (one finding on a leaf) the run goes back to review/review without rendering again, and a fresh clone of the re-pushed branch fails rhiza check: missing rendered/actor page for the cycle-2 verifier, index.md differs.

Built this branch's binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified. rhiza run start <leafless accepted change set> --permission-mode manual exited 3 with 'has no leaves: ship-change builds and reviews its leaves, so plan it first' and next 'rhiza run start --workflow plan'; no run directory was added and no worktree was made.

Built this branch's binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified. Inside the ship-change run, open-pr pushed cs/ship-it and ran gh pr create --title 'Ship it' with the run summary as body ('# Review of run ...'); after request-changes the second open-pr pushed the fixer's commits and ran gh pr edit, with exactly one pr create; run status named the PR URL. Outside a run, rhiza ship open-pr exited 2 saying RHIZA_RUN is not set.

Built this branch's binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified. ship-change stopped at signoff after green CI with run status naming the PR URL; rhiza run approve carried on to rebase, land and merge. rhiza run request-changes with one finding (check qa, leaf thing2) ran a fixer then the leaf's verifier, re-ran only check qa as cycle 2 under review/review, then open-pr (pr edit), wait-pr, pr-green and stopped at signoff again.

Built this branch's binary (go build ./cmd/rhiza), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified. ship-change's workflow steps ran the built-in build and review inside one run and journal: steps journaled as build/build, build/check, review/code, review/review in order; review's signoff was skipped (the run went from review/review to open-pr); both workflow steps passed and the outer on.pass steps followed.
